name: lsp_initialize
description: Initialize a language server for the current project root.
usageHint: Use before requesting semantic code information. For workspace-scoped stdio servers, root_path may be "." because runtime starts the server in the workspace deliverable directory; lang_id must match the target language.
outputSummary: initialization status and language server metadata

name: lsp_sync
description: Synchronize the complete current file content into the language server buffer.
usageHint: Use after a file change when the language server needs the full latest file content. Provide a workspace-relative file path or file_path plus complete content; do not send only root_path or partial diffs.

name: lsp_definition
description: Resolve the definition location for a symbol position.
usageHint: Use with 0-based line and col. Empty results are inconclusive, not proof that the symbol is absent.

name: lsp_hover
description: Read semantic hover information for a symbol position.
usageHint: Use with 0-based line and col. Keep hover text concise when using it as context.

name: lsp_references
description: Find references for a symbol position.
usageHint: Preserve total, limit, and truncated flags. truncated=true is only a partial reference set.

name: lsp_diagnostics
description: Read file or project diagnostics from the language server.
usageHint: Diagnostics are auxiliary evidence and cannot replace build/test/lint or direct DoD evidence.

name: lsp_status
description: Inspect current language server instance state, dependency availability, activity, and restart counters.
usageHint: Use as auxiliary runtime evidence when semantic capability health affects diagnosis. Status output cannot replace build/test/lint or direct DoD evidence.
inputSummary: optional root_path, lang_id, or instance selector
outputSummary: language server instance status and dependency health

name: lsp_shutdown
description: Close one language server instance or all instances owned by the current workspace session.
usageHint: Use only for bounded workspace-local semantic session cleanup or recovery. It is not deliverable state-change evidence.
inputSummary: optional root_path, lang_id, instance id, or all flag

name: lsp_repair
description: Diagnose or perform safe workspace-local language server session recovery such as restarting an exited instance.
usageHint: Use for auxiliary semantic capability recovery. apply=true may only perform safe instance-level recovery and cannot modify deliverable files.
outputSummary: repair recommendation or safe recovery result
